info.name: KHR_RENDERER_BACKGROUND_COLOR
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension; parameters are identical, the description documents this device's background alpha semantics.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: background color and alpha; camera rays that miss all geometry write this color and alpha into channel.color (alpha < 1 renders on a transparent film and composites color over coverage in the output driver: alpha = coverage + (1-coverage)*background.a); a camera-visible HDRI light overrides the background entirely (alpha stays 1)
